sloka: यश्चैष विन्ध्यास्तमहेन्द्रकल्पो धन्वी रथस्थो ऽतिरथो ऽतिवीरः ।विस्फारयंश्चापमतुल्यमानं नाम्ना ऽतिकायो ऽतिविवृद्धकायः ।। ६.५९.१६ ।।।।

translations.english: "He who resembles Vindhya Mountain in the west (where the sun sets) and the Mahendra mountain (in size) seated on the chariot, is a great chariotwarrior, a hero unequalled in size, wielding a bow whose body is grown out of size, who is coming in sight is by name Atikaya."
